captions.en: First, we walked left to right, reflecting on each keyword,
then walked back right to left, looking at it all in reverse.
Looking back on my path to spirituality, I saw how hard I'd fought just to be myself.
It made me a little sad. I'd struggled so hard to escape my circumstances.
And now I've come all the way back.
So I began wondering how to live as myself, without worrying about my circumstances.
For me, spirituality means God. God is light, so I receive that light,
and with that love, whether I'm running a business or anything else,
I knew my relationship with God had to come first.
I've always wanted to live naturally.
Just as God made me. There must be a reason I was made this way, so I longed to live close to nature.
I wanted a place where every shape is welcome: circles, triangles, stars.
Coming back the other way, I realized how much freedom matters to me.
In fighting for that freedom, I'd been creating something out of nothing.
That's why the body matters, and why wellness matters so much.

captions.en: I'm someone who needs to feel alive, and this energy is my greatest asset,

captions.big:

잘 지켜야겠다 싶었어요
captions.en: so I want to protect it.

captions.big:
사랑과 빛이 있어야
이 모든 걸 할 수 있어요
captions.en: In the end, I can only do all of this with the love and light I receive from God,
so now I want to grow my spirituality by truly living it out.
